instruction: How to issue a certificate with lego using DigitalOcean DNS
output: export DO_AUTH_TOKEN='your_do_token' && lego --dns digitalocean --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to issue a certificate with lego using Google Cloud DNS
output: export GCE_PROJECT='my-project' && lego --dns gcloud --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to issue a certificate with lego using Azure DNS
output: export AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP='my-rg' && lego --dns azure --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to issue a certificate with lego using OVH DNS
output: export OVH_ENDPOINT='ovh-eu' && export OVH_APPLICATION_KEY='app_key' && lego --dns ovh --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to issue a certificate with lego using Gandi DNS
output: export GANDIV5_API_KEY='your_gandi_key' && lego --dns gandiv5 --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to issue a certificate with lego using Linode DNS
output: export LINODE_TOKEN='your_linode_token' && lego --dns linode --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to issue a certificate with lego using Vultr DNS
output: export VULTR_API_KEY='your_vultr_key' && lego --dns vultr --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to issue a certificate with lego using Namecheap DNS
output: export NAMECHEAP_API_USER='user' && export NAMECHEAP_API_KEY='key' && lego --dns namecheap --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to issue a certificate with lego using Hetzner DNS
output: export HETZNER_API_TOKEN='your_token' && lego --dns hetzner --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to issue a certificate with lego using DuckDNS
output: export DUCKDNS_TOKEN='your_token' && lego --dns duckdns --email admin@example.com --domains mydomain.duckdns.org --accept-tos run

instruction: How to issue a certificate with lego using CloudDNS (Google)
output: export GCE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT='/path/to/sa.json' && lego --dns gcloud --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to issue a certificate with lego using RFC2136 DNS
output: export RFC2136_NAMESERVER='ns1.example.com:53' && export RFC2136_TSIG_KEY='key_name' && lego --dns rfc2136 --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to set environment variables for lego AWS Route53 DNS
output: export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID='AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE' && export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY='wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY' && lego --dns route53 --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to issue a wildcard certificate with lego and Cloudflare DNS
output: export CF_API_EMAIL='admin@example.com' && export CF_API_KEY='your_global_key' && lego --dns cloudflare --email admin@example.com --domains '*.example.com' --accept-tos run

instruction: How to issue a certificate with lego using Cloudflare API token
output: export CF_DNS_API_TOKEN='your_token' && lego --dns cloudflare --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to set custom DNS propagation timeout for lego
output: export LEGO_DISABLE_CNAME_SUPPORT=true && lego --dns cloudflare --dns-timeout 120 --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to issue a certificate with lego using DNS challenge and custom resolvers
output: lego --dns route53 --dns.resolvers '8.8.8.8:53,1.1.1.1:53' --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to use lego with no propagation check
output: export LEGO_EXPERIMENTAL_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT=0 && lego --dns cloudflare --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to issue a multi-domain certificate with lego and OVH DNS
output: export OVH_ENDPOINT='ovh-eu' && lego --dns ovh --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --domains www.example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to specify DNS challenge filename for lego
output: lego --dns rfc2136 --dns.filename /etc/lego/dns.json --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to disable CNAME support for lego DNS challenge
output: export LEGO_DISABLE_CNAME_SUPPORT=true && lego --dns cloudflare --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run

instruction: How to set a custom propagation timeout for a specific DNS provider in lego
output: lego --dns cloudflare --dns-timeout 90 --email admin@example.com --domains '*.example.com' --accept-tos run

instruction: How to issue a certificate with lego using PDNS (PowerDNS)
output: export PDNS_API_URL='http://pdns.example.com' && export PDNS_API_KEY='key' && lego --dns pdns --email admin@example.com --domains example.com --accept-tos run
